selectionGuide.description: One astronaut discovers a broad truth about Earth while a second armed astronaut confirms that the truth was never new.
bestFor: a belated realization about a long-standing condition
revealing that apparently different things share the same underlying trait
an ominous confirmation that the discovery changes nothing
avoidWhen: the joke is an ordinary preference rather than a revelation
there is no established truth for the response to confirm
the punchline needs several intermediate stages

mechanics.visual: The first astronaut's discovery creates the setup, and the armed figure behind them turns confirmation into a threatening punchline.
mechanics.text: Phrase realization as a concise surprised question, then make response a terse, confident confirmation such as 'Always has been.'

slots.name: realization
slots.hint: the shocking realization, e.g. 'wait, it's all X?'
